summary: Build practical knowledge audits, lessons learned registers, and governance tools in this 5-day training. Strengthen programme continuity and reporting.
lede: Knowledge management for development programmes helps teams capture, organise and reuse programme learning through staff changes and project closure. For professionals working with programme documents, reporting, coordination or field evidence, the course provides practical ways to map knowledge assets, assess knowledge flows and record lessons from delivery. Participants also practise structuring repositories and metadata, planning communities of practice, and setting governance and reporting routines that keep information accessible and support learning.
audienceIntro: This course is intended for professionals who already work with programme documents, reporting cycles, or coordination routines and need a more structured way to manage institutional learning. You will get the most value if you handle programme knowledge, field evidence, project closure, partner coordination, or leadership reporting in development settings.
prerequisites: Participants should bring a laptop for exercises, sample programme documents if available, and access to a basic spreadsheet or document editor. Prior experience with programme reporting, file management, or lessons learned processes will help you apply the workshop tools faster.
